purpose: Recovery of an already-mismatched pending review; successful recovery is not demonstrated by this plan.
noSyntheticAuthority: No JSON fixture field or test cast may stand in for the missing genuine runtime-issued authority. Positive recovery cases must use the real isolated gateway/native lifecycle and canonical store implementation.

cases.scenario: already mismatched review/binding
cases.action: Run reconciliation with real test-native owner/configuration evidence and compatible authorized original catalog.
cases.expected: Binding returns to reviewed-thread-A; identical review-R remains pending; no native/model turn, findings edit, source spoofing, or replacement thread.

cases.scenario: same damaged state after prevention-only upgrade
cases.action: Run the new recovery regression on PR179054 alone.
cases.expected: Regression remains red: the prevention guard cannot restore the already-replaced binding.

cases.scenario: reconciliation unavailable
cases.action: Native broker cannot establish current ownership/configuration.
cases.expected: Return unavailable; no binding/review mutation or native turn.

cases.scenario: viewer or unauthorized operator
cases.expected: Deny before native preparation or any write.

cases.scenario: synthetic client or sender-attributed request
cases.expected: Deny; never impersonate an operator UI or original channel sender.

cases.scenario: wrong review or session lifecycle
cases.expected: Conflict; preserve all current state.

cases.scenario: client supplies target thread, owner, catalog or policy
cases.expected: Reject schema; server derives target only from the genuine pending review.

cases.scenario: original belongs to another native home or conversation
cases.action: Attempt recovery from matching-looking historical records.
cases.expected: Refuse; historical association and advisory registry membership cannot grant ownership.

cases.scenario: foreign native subscriber or active native turn
cases.expected: Refuse or wait with bounded cancellation; do not steal subscription, terminate work or weaken policy.

cases.scenario: failed-run writer identity remains recorded
cases.expected: Require canonical runtime owner reconciliation; never delete the writer field or infer idle from failed status.

cases.scenario: latest failed turn or findings changed
cases.expected: Refuse through unchanged identity/latest-failure/findings checks.

cases.scenario: current executor policy denies an original declared tool
cases.expected: Refuse; retain original declarations unchanged and do not resurrect denied executors.

cases.scenario: native profile or effective configuration is unknown
cases.action: Receive incomplete or non-attested native response.
cases.expected: Return unavailable; requested config and matching JSON fields alone cannot mint authority.

cases.scenario: provider ignores requested approval/sandbox/reviewer settings
cases.expected: Refuse; do not hash requested settings and claim they took effect.

cases.scenario: catalog changed or fingerprint/metadata identity invalid
cases.expected: Refuse under the existing parser, home/path and fingerprint checks.

cases.scenario: original native catalog has 43 functions; UI has 61
cases.action: Prepare a review-owned native surface under the proposed broker.
cases.expected: Succeed only if exact original declarations map to currently authorized, schema-compatible executors; otherwise report incompatible. No truncation, fabricated supervision scope or source spoofing.

cases.scenario: runtime/client/config generation changes during preparation
cases.expected: Invalidate observation and refuse before commit; preserve review.

cases.scenario: review or host authority changes during native read
cases.expected: Refuse before binding commit; dispose only this operation's resources.

cases.scenario: binding changes concurrently, including same thread with changed policy/client
cases.expected: Full preimage/revision CAS fails; never overwrite the winner.

cases.scenario: duplicate identical operation after committed reconciliation
cases.action: Repeat operationId with identical target and parameters.
cases.expected: Return recorded consistent result without native preparation, second write, acknowledgment or turn.

cases.scenario: operationId reused for different review/session/request
cases.expected: Conflict; do not reuse receipts or broaden authority.

cases.scenario: native ownership acquired, binding commit rejected
cases.expected: Conditionally release only acquired reservation/subscription; leave binding and review untouched. No blind snapshot restore.

cases.scenario: binding committed, reply lost
cases.expected: Return/reconcile known committed result; never automatically repeat native admission or roll back the binding.

cases.scenario: native preparation outcome unknown
cases.action: Lose response during native configuration/subscription handoff.
cases.expected: Persist uncertain outcome and block retries; read current native/canonical evidence before any further action.

cases.scenario: process crash in prepared or committed phase
cases.action: Restart isolated test gateway and inspect journal.
cases.expected: Recover disposition from canonical CAS/receipt and actual native ownership; preserve review; no automatic acknowledgment or replay.

cases.scenario: subscription cleanup or conditional rollback loses ownership
cases.expected: Do not touch another owner's subscription/binding; report uncertain and retain hold.

cases.scenario: displaced replacement contains accepted input or consequential work
cases.expected: Refuse and preserve both histories; do not merge, discard or replay work.

cases.scenario: successful consistency repair
cases.expected: Review remains byte-for-byte identical and pending; continuationApproved=false; queued inputs remain held.

cases.scenario: separate explicit normal acknowledgment after repair
cases.action: Use unchanged sessions.providerReview.continue and native review validator.
cases.expected: Original thread and failed turn/findings/runtime validated again; only genuine provider acceptance of a distinct native turn retires review. No automatic replay of held inputs.

cases.scenario: only stored flags or serialized observations exist
cases.action: Attempt native catalog preparation or commit.
cases.expected: Reject unissued/stale observations; persisted data and TypeScript brands are not executable authority.

cases.scenario: current MCP/app/skills/network policy becomes incompatible
cases.expected: Refuse with specific compatibility reason; no policy rollback or broadening.
